title: Act 2's overview text distinguishes 'the pilgrim stair at Coldpass' (three hollows rested) from 'the covenant carried out of the Meres (the Keepers' stair)' as if they were two different routes, but both resolve to the exact same action at the exact same room (The Pass Gate / 'climb the Keepers' pilgrim stair'), which reads as one path described twice.
